title: Independence Day — office closed Sat 15 Aug
body: The Bellandur office is closed on Saturday 15 August for Independence Day. On-call rotations continue as scheduled; swap requests go to your manager by Thursday.

title: Health insurance mid-year enrollment window open
body: Additions of dependents (spouse, children, parents) are open until 20 August. Submit nominee and dependent details from My Space → Profile. E-cards arrive within 10 working days of the window closing.

title: Q2 all-hands recording and deck
body: The recording and slides from the Q2 all-hands are on the intranet under Company → All-hands. Highlights: two enterprise logos closed, platform uptime at 99.97%, and the hiring plan for H2.
